investigation.name: Demo · real case: Jardine Matheson and Jardine Strategic owned each other (Bermuda, 2021)
investigation.question: How did Jardine Matheson and Jardine Strategic hold shares in each other before their 2021 amalgamation, and what else did Jardine Strategic hold?
investigation.description: A demo built from one public record: the Supreme Court of Bermuda's judgment of 12 November 2021 giving directions in the dissenting shareholders' appraisal actions after Jardine Strategic's amalgamation. Its background, taken from the affidavit of the Group General Counsel, sets out the cross-holding between the two listed companies: Jardine Matheson held, indirectly, about 84.9% of Jardine Strategic, and Jardine Strategic held, directly and indirectly, 59.3% of Jardine Matheson. Quoted exactly. Loaded to show the ownership-loop red flag (BO-001) on a real record.

events.title: Jardine Strategic and Jardine Matheson announce plans to simplify the Group's structure
events.description: First, Jardine Matheson buys for cash the roughly 15% of Jardine Strategic it does not own; then it cancels Jardine Strategic's almost 59% shareholding in it.

evidence.quote: On 8 March 2021, the Company and Jardine Matheson announced plans to simplify the structure of the Group.

events.title: Jardine Strategic's general meeting approves the Amalgamation Agreement

evidence.quote: At the General Meeting of the Company held on 12 April 2021, a resolution approving the Amalgamation Agreement was passed.

events.title: The amalgamation takes effect: Jardine Strategic Holdings and JMH Bermuda continue as Jardine Strategic Limited

evidence.quote: The Amalgamation became effective on 14 April 2021.

events.title: Supreme Court of Bermuda gives directions in the dissenting shareholders' appraisal actions
events.description: Hargun CJ, in 18 actions seeking appraisal of the fair value of the dissenting shareholders' shares in Jardine Strategic Holdings.

evidence.quote: Date of Judgment: 12 November 2021

claims.text: Before the 2021 amalgamation, Jardine Matheson and Jardine Strategic owned each other: Jardine Matheson held, indirectly, about 84.9% of Jardine Strategic, and Jardine Strategic held, directly and indirectly, 59.3% of Jardine Matheson.
claims.rationale: Stated in the Supreme Court of Bermuda's judgment, from the Group General Counsel's affidavit.

evidence.quote: Prior to the Amalgamation, amongst other interests in the Group, Jardine Matheson held, indirectly, approximately 84.9% of the shares in the Company.
The Group’s structure included a cross-holding structure between the two listed companies. The Company owned, directly and indirectly, 59.3% of the shares in Jardine Matheson.

claims.text: Jardine Matheson undertook to vote, and to have its wholly-owned subsidiaries vote, 940,903,135 Jardine Strategic shares (84.89%) for the amalgamation, so its approval was certain.
claims.rationale: Stated in the Supreme Court of Bermuda's judgment.

evidence.quote: Jardine Matheson had undertaken to the Company that it would vote and would procure that its wholly-owned subsidiaries would vote the 940,903,135 shares (representing 84.89% of the existing issued share capital of the Company) in favour of the resolution. The requisite approval was therefore certain to be secured.

leads.title: Which subsidiaries held the cross-holding?
leads.detail: The judgment says Jardine Matheson's 84.9% was held indirectly and Jardine Strategic's 59.3% directly and indirectly, but names no intermediate company. Find them in the two companies' 2020 annual reports.

leads.title: When was Jardine Strategic's stake in Jardine Matheson cancelled?
leads.detail: The plan announced on 8 March 2021 ended with Jardine Matheson cancelling Jardine Strategic's almost 59% shareholding in it; this judgment deals only with the first step.
